newsitem.title: USA: Nucor Steel using CTG technology at 2 mills.
newsitem.headline: Nucor Steel using CTG technology at 2 mills.

text.p: Computer Task Group Inc said Friday it has successfully implemented its OneVISION system at Nucor Corp steel mills in Crawfordsville, Ind., and Berkeley County, S.C.
CTG said its contracts were valued at about $1.5 million.

CTG said its Metals Center, in Pittsburgh, Pa., customized and installed OneVISION open-systems information technology software to provide a plant-wide material tracking system at both Nucor facilities, and implemented the CSP process computer system for mill management and quality control at the Berkeley County plant.
